cards.anchor: P1 supplies P2; immediate inspection returns rack space. B9 requires correction despite its packing mark. Two trolley allowances permit a hypothesized boundary where adding a singleton powered trip increases occupied transfer minutes without improving correct releases.
cards.burden: Transfer clerk changes vehicle and follows fixed departures; inspection clerk counts, corrects B9 and seals in arrival order. Exit occupies transfer for a predicted nine minutes, one more than normal. Ledger captures both clerks separately.
cards.construction: Normal: trolley B4-B7 at 0-3, then hand B8-B12 consecutively at 3-8. Higher dose: identical first trolley, singleton trolley B8 at 3-6, then hand B9-B12 consecutively at 6-10. Inspect each eligible next carrier immediately. If triggered, exit uses only consecutive hand trips B4-B12 at 0-9 with immediate inspection, preserving all identifiers, inspection and correction. Physical activation is unqualified pending independent reset resources.
cards.defeat: Either completed higher-dose trial ties or beats its normal control, or hand exit fails twelve correct releases by 13, defeats the proposed harmful-boundary exit. Missing trials establish no trigger.
cards.mutation: Predeclare a switch away from powered-trolley dependency only when BOTH independently reset matched higher-dose trials worsen the exact present metric versus their normal-dose controls; otherwise hold normal.
cards.prediction_candidate: Finite-model prediction: both schedules complete twelve correct releases by 13; normal occupies transfer for eight minutes, higher for ten. Each matched pair therefore worsens the metric. Dependency-free hand exit predicts twelve correct releases by 13 and nine occupied transfer minutes.
cards.prediction_rival: At least one completed higher-dose trial uses no more occupied transfer minutes than its completed normal control; the two-pair trigger fails.
cards.probe: Fix two independently reset normal/higher trial pairs with identical O1 demand before observation. Exact metric: twelve correct sealed releases by minute 13 outranks failure; among successes fewer occupied transfer-clerk minutes wins; failures against failures are unordered. Record unload identities, correct releases, occupied intervals, rack occupancy, waits and charge with clock and ledger. No post-result cutoff.
cards.rival: Additional powered service preserves present success without increasing transfer occupation relative to the fixed normal schedule.
unknowns: Untestable assumption: four independently reset physical trials are obtainable. Reset facilities, replacement consumed seals and restored trolley charge are not supplied; declared resources cannot establish this physical trigger.
B9 discrepancy cause and any later downstream adaptation remain unknown; neither changes fixed demand.
No trials, measured threshold, observed benefit or global optimality proof are supplied.
